TODO: page in progress.

- Endpoints: `/api/v1/{module}/{resource}`
- OpenAPI: `artifacts/openapi.json` on every build
- Auth: `Authorization: Bearer <JWT>`
- Versioning: URL prefix
- Filters: Yandex-Cloud-style
- Pagination: cursor-based
- Idempotency: `Idempotency-Key`
- Error format: RFC 9457 ProblemDetails
